name: 2.9.6 - Phone RO fix
notes: Phone RO fix: a Repair Order kept open for you in COSTAR Tempe (an online order's, or one waiting for review) no longer holds the phone's Repair Orders back: it stays exactly as it is, and the one you ask for opens beside it. They also go into COSTAR Tempe whichever branch the helper is set to. Includes 2.9.5 (Update now) and 2.9.4. Update the RDP helper (and the desk PC, to keep them the same).
